rationale: The baked C++ lane's fidelity report no longer notes style values it already renders as unlowered: mix-blend-mode normal; filter, backdrop-filter, clip-path and transform none; text-overflow clip; pointer-events auto; a solid border, or one whose every side has a recorded width of zero. It changes diagnostics only, not lowering, rendering or authority.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'generate_pulp_cpp does not report a style property set to its initial keyword'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'generate_pulp_cpp reports the style properties it cannot lower'
